email.body1:
Bridget, saw Corcentric expanded its procurement ecosystem this year and brought in new leadership on the capital equipment side of fleet.

Expanding the surface area usually means more in-market accounts than the team can touch before reps ramp on the new motion, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for fleet procurement off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your fleet number
email.body2:
Bridget, quick follow-up for the fleet procurement team.

As the ecosystem grows, target accounts usually outrun the team's capacity to work them. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings reps need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings fleet procurement needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bridget, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer procurement teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bridget, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling fleet pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority while the new partnerships bed in, no problem at all. I know expansion quarters carry their own load.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fleet procurement motion? I'll tailor it to Corcentric either way.
